name: AskMyMoney
description: A ChatGPT-native personal finance assistant that connects to your bank via Plaid and lets you manage your money using pure natural language.
content: People want to understand their finances, but traditional budgeting apps force them into rigid dashboards, categories, and static UI. AskMyMoney flips it: your finances become fully conversational. Everything is answered with live transaction data, inside ChatGPT. Key features: Plaid integration, Financial Q&A, Automatic transaction enrichment, Multi-account support, Personalized summaries.
